summary: Iteration-6 testing of ElevenLabs voices (natural-sounding), human-handoff webhook+UI alerts, super-admin Stripe settings, custom-voice CRUD, voice-cost pricing fields and build_assistant payload shape. New backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_vozlead_iter6.py — 20/20 tests passing. Full backend regression now 101 passed, 1 skipped across 4 files. Frontend Playwright verified: (1) VozLead agent builder /app/agentes/{id} Voz tab renders voice-group-eleven with 8 ElevenLabs voices (agent-voice-e_sarah, e_matilda, e_jessica, e_laura, e_chris, e_eric, e_roger, e_will) plus voice-group-premium + voice-group-standard, and saving an agent with e_sarah via agent-builder-save-button succeeds (200). (2) Costes page /app/costes shows voice-cost-compare table with voice-cost-11labs/cartesia/azure rows and pricing-voice_{11labs,cartesia,azure}_usd_min-input fields; PUT /api/admin/pricing with voice fields persists. (3) Super admin /app/admin shows stripe-settings-panel, stripe-status-test, custom-voices-panel, voice-name-input; non-admin gets 403 on /api/admin/stripe; invalid key sk_test_invalid123456 returns 400. (4) Mi plan /app/plan shows billing-current and 3 billing-plan-buy-{id} buttons in EUR; POST /api/billing/checkout returns a real checkout.stripe.com URL and session_id; other-user/invalid-plan sessions return 404. (5) Human handoff: POST /api/vapi/webhook with x-vapi-secret and request_human toolCallList creates a kind='humano' support ticket with best_time, flips lead.wants_human=true, and surfaces in header human-request-alert, sidebar-support-count badge, and /app/asistencia support-human-badge-{id} rendering the best_time 'por la tarde'; support-resolve-{id} clears that specific ticket. (6) build_assistant unit test: ElevenLabs voice -> provider '11labs', model 'eleven_turbo_v2_5', language 'es', fallbackPlan.voices[0].provider='cartesia', model.model='gpt-4.1', request_human tool present, transcriber deepgram nova-3 es for ES / nova-2 es-419 for CL, startSpeakingPlan+stopSpeakingPlan present. (7) Existing agents all migrated to e_*/x_* voices.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/billing.py checkout: unit_amount is sent as int(round(price_eur*100)) which is correct, but amount_for returns int(round(plan['price_clp'])) for CLP — CLP is a zero-decimal currency per Stripe, so this is correct. Just flag: no cap/min, so a plan with price_clp=0 would raise HTTPException(400). Good.

backend/vapi.py voice_config fallback: uses hardcoded 'l_fernanda'/'l_mateo' (CL) and 'p_marta'/'p_gonzalo' (ES) as fallback — hardcoded voice IDs mean if these are later removed from PREMIUM, build_assistant will KeyError. Consider adding safety fallback.

backend/extra_routes.py admin_costs: voices[k]['per_min'] uses measured value only when minutes>=5 else configured — fine; but when minutes<5 and no leads for provider, measured_per_min stays None which is correctly surfaced.

backend/saas.py tool_human: 'best_time' is optional in schema but stored as empty string when missing; UI should handle empty best_time (not render that row) — confirmed Support.jsx conditionally renders it.
backend/billing.py stripe_connect: deletes old webhook only when key is unchanged — if admin rotates key, old webhook on old account is left dangling. Low priority.
frontend DashboardLayout header-create-agent-button hardcoded link to /nuevo; no UX bug but duplicates agents-create-button.

success_rate.backend: 100% (20/20 iter-6 tests, 101/101 full regression excluding 1 pre-existing skip)
